title: Off-record source: the sun as a portal to other star systems

tellings.quote: And he made this analogy of the sun being some sort of like portal to other star systems.

plain: The sun could be a kind of portal to other star systems: that is the comparison a source once made to Michels, he says. Michels brings it up while talking with Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA trained him to communicate with aliens, and he does not name the source or say anything more about the idea.
